svg.text: B.Com III Semester End-Semester Examination 2026-27 · Paper BCM-301 · Corporate Accounting (demo paper code)
The balance sheet of Kesarwani Traders Ltd shows total assets of ₹12,50,000
(including goodwill of ₹50,000), outside liabilities of ₹3,00,000, 10% preference
share capital of ₹2,00,000 and 50,000 equity shares of ₹10 each. Goodwill is
revalued at ₹1,00,000. Calculate the intrinsic value of one equity share (net assets
method).
Pandey Ltd takes over the business of Rastogi Ltd. The assets of Rastogi Ltd are
taken over at ₹9,00,000 and its creditors at ₹1,50,000. Pandey Ltd pays ₹1,50,000 in
cash and the balance by issuing equity shares of ₹10 each at ₹15 per share.
Calculate the purchase consideration (net assets method) and the number of shares
issued, and pass the entries in the books of Pandey Ltd (amalgamation in the nature
of purchase).
SECTION C · LONG ANSWERS · 15 MARKS EACH
Bajpai Industries Ltd has, for the year ended 31 March 2026: revenue from operations
₹15,00,000, other income ₹40,000, cost of materials consumed ₹8,20,000, employee
benefits ₹1,80,000, finance costs ₹30,000 and other expenses ₹1,00,000. Machinery of
₹5,00,000 is to be depreciated at 10%. Managerial remuneration is payable at 5% of
the profit before managerial remuneration and tax, and tax is to be provided at
₹60,000. The board proposes a dividend of 10% on equity share capital of ₹10,00,000.
Prepare the statement of profit and loss and show how the items appear in the
balance sheet as per Schedule III.
H Ltd acquired 80% of the equity shares of S Ltd on 1 April 2025 for ₹5,60,000. On
that date S Ltd had share capital of ₹5,00,000 and reserves of ₹1,00,000; during
2025-26 it earned a profit of ₹1,50,000. S Ltd owes H Ltd ₹40,000 for goods
supplied, and the closing stock of H Ltd includes goods bought from S Ltd for
₹30,000 at cost plus 25%. Prepare working notes for the analysis of profits,
minority interest, cost of control and unrealised profit, and show these items in
the consolidated balance sheet as at 31 March 2026.
*** END OF QUESTION PAPER ***
